About me

I am a PhD Candidate in Biostatistics at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public health (anticipated graduation in May 2027), advised by Elizabeth Stuart and Trang Nguyen. My research interests broadly include causal inference, electronic health records, algorithmic fairness, and mental health. My dissertation work focuses specifically on the challenge of unobserved confounding.
